payload.description: CoordinationSession dispatchDeclaredOperation: give the existing 'fresher unconsumed authorization for the same (node, operation, actor) binding' refusal a stable machine-readable code (e.g. authorization-duplicate-unconsumed) carrying nodeId/operationId/actorId and the remedy (distinct taskKey), instead of message text only, so the Continuation Planner and CLI can translate it into a typed next action. No semantic change to authorization or taskKey matching. Origin: docs/architect/agent-coordination/architecture/coordination-continuation-recovery.md §2 C-c (design review 2026-09-11).

patch.description: CoordinationSession openSession: validate partialPolicy shape against the bound FlowDefinition before open, as the engine-side implementation of tsk-40j's second fix direction (review-only cell must pair actors[] with explicit partialPolicy.allowedOmissions up front). Refuse with a stable reason code (a) a review-only request whose steps target only a subset of actors[] and declares no allowedOmissions covering the rest (tsk-40j), and (b) allowedOmissions that would let the session close partially while a driver-authorized follow-up operation (fixer) is still pending after first quorum -- (b) only if tsk-5qj keeps auto-close semantics; if tsk-5qj fixes auto-close, (b) becomes unnecessary, hence the dependency. Validation only; does not change the R1 'declared up front' invariant. Origin: docs/architect/agent-coordination/architecture/coordination-continuation-recovery.md §2 C-a/C-b (design review 2026-09-11).
